summary: The staged plan is technically consistent with the existing pilot and deployed source. It addresses paired-process cleanup races, bounded inspection and teardown, original versus late UART evidence, and existing-server client semantics. No blocking findings.
checks: Compared the plan with child_main, wait_files, run_controller, stop_children and the deployed allocation/barrier lifecycle.
Verified that successful peers currently deallocate before publishing results, supporting the proposed parent-controlled decision point.
Checked early-success, target/non-target failure, missing-peer, final-trial and warm-reuse transitions, including suspension of ordinary timers during a bounded hold.
Reviewed immutable failure evidence, separate bounded late-RX retention, diagnostic coherence limits and cleanup on capture errors.
Verified SimpleClient.value uses cached access while get requests a read, and that generic GUI/VirtualClient access remains write-capable.
Verified PyRogue GUI invocation, dynamic base-port discovery, three-port server reporting and wildcard-address behavior; confirmed devGui constructs another root.
Reviewed release, deadline, signal, parent-death and child-local cleanup requirements and their proposed offline coverage.
Checked that rehearsal, natural target reproduction, implementation review and later hardware authorization remain distinct.
Read the November 9 results and cleanup record supporting the historical 12 successful camera calls and their stated limitations.
limitations: This was a read-only document review. No implementation, runtime tests, hardware access, GUI attachment or external-service calls were performed.
The proposed control protocol, diagnostics, client compatibility and parent-death handling still require implementation tests and independent code review.
The actual hold feature and existing-server inspection have not been validated on hardware; earlier successful trials do not establish those capabilities or reproduce issue 205.
Source/hash and commit-hook validation supplied by the coordinator was not independently repeated.
